answer: Each AI identity must escrow a bond before it can vote, trade, or collect fees, and a random challenge selects peers to audit its work. In a zephyr round, an atlas records commitments and a whisper channel reveals matching answers or coordinated timing; a verifier then slashes linked bonds. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and risks losing all collateral when correlation exposes the cluster, making mass forgery more expensive than honest participation.
